historical_references.reference: Al-Idrisi mentions Gharab as a town in the Maghreb region and a significant stop on the trans-Saharan trade route during the 12th century.
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi's 'The Description of the World' is a geographical reference work detailing the known world at the time.
